Aamir Khan, Hrithik Roshan Join Producers Guild; Sarkar Re-elected President

Actors Aamir Khan and Hrithik Roshan have joined the Producers Guild council. The producer of 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' has been re-elected as president of the Producers Guild.
